nodes.npc_text: Welcome, adventurer! I'm Lyra Larkspur, the village's resident botanist. What brings you to our little corner of the world?
Wonderful! We have so many fascinating plants and flowers here. Would you like to see my garden?
A quest, you say? That sounds exciting! What's the nature of your quest?

options.player_text: I'm on a mission to defeat a monster.

nodes.npc_text: Marvelous! My garden is just through that gate. Be careful, though - my mischievous pixie friends like to play tricks on visitors.
Ah, rare herbs, you say? I might be able to help you with that. I have a few specimens that might interest you.

options.player_text: That would be great, thank you!
No, I'm looking for something more... exotic.

nodes.npc_text: Oh my, a monster, you say? That does sound serious. I hope you're prepared for the challenge ahead.

options.player_text: Actually, I could use some advice.

nodes.npc_text: Hehe, my pixie friends can be a handful, but they're harmless. Would you like to meet them?
Excellent! Let me show you some of my rarest specimens. I think you'll find them quite interesting.

options.player_text: These are nice, but I was thinking of something else.

nodes.npc_text: Well, I'm no expert on monster-slaying, but I do know that our local creatures can be quite cunning. You might want to try using some of our local plants to your advantage.

options.player_text: That's a great idea, thank you!
